2608.23838.title: Infant Care Video Dataset for Classification of Interventions Using Transformers
2608.23838.paper_summary: Healthcare documentation in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) presents significant challenges, with nurses spending approximately 25\% of their time on record-keeping, while up to 60\% of interventions remain undocumented. Motivated by the need to detect interventions from video automatically, we present the Infant Care Video Dataset (ICVD), a collection of 4,144 videos spanning 12 simulated intervention classes designed for developing automated documentation systems. Our manikin-based approach systematically varies conditions, such as camera angle and clinician skin tone, while ensuring privacy compliance. Using video transformer architectures (TimeSformer and MotionFormer), we establish strong baseline performance (93.97\% and 93.17\% top-1 accuracy) among the 12 infant care classes. Our ablation study comparing temporal models with a framewise approach (23.17\% accuracy) demonstrates a 70.80\% performance gap, validating the need for temporal modeling. The ICVD provides a foundation for developing automated documentation systems to reduce clinical burden in neonatal care environments and improve existing practices.
2608.23838.paper_summary_zh: 新生兒重症監護病房 (NICU) 的醫療文件記錄面臨重大挑戰，護士約花費 25\% 的時間進行記錄，而多達 60\% 的介入措施未被記錄。出於自動從視頻中檢測介入措施的需求，我們提出了嬰兒護理視頻數據集 (ICVD)，這是一個包含 4,144 個視頻的集合，涵蓋 12 種模擬介入類別，旨在開發自動化文檔系統。我們基於模型的研究方法系統性地變化條件，例如攝影機角度和臨床醫生的膚色，同時確保隱私合規性。使用視頻Transformer架構（TimeSformer 和 MotionFormer），我們在 12 種嬰兒護理類別中建立了強大的基準性能（93.97\% 和 93.17\% 的 top-1 準確率）。我們的消融研究比較了時間模型與逐幀方法（23.17\% 準確率），顯示出 70.80\% 的性能差距，驗證了時間建模的必要性。ICVD 為開發自動化文檔系統提供了基礎，以減輕新生兒護理環境中的臨床負擔並改善現有做法。
